title: Medical Retina Specialist
description:
**Role :**
Medical Retina specialist with interest in ROP screening and treatment
  
  
**Industry type:**
Medical Services/ Hospital
  
  
**Key skills:**
The ideal candidate should-
  
  

* be proficient in diagnosing and managing wide spectrum of retinal disorders
* have expertise in screening, diagnosing and treating ROP in neonates

**Type of employment:**
Full/Part time
  
  
**Job Location:**
Thiruvalla, Kerala (Central Kerala)
  
  
**Languages:**
English, Any
  
  
**Experience:**
Prior experience will be an added advantage
  
  
**Qualifications**

* MBBS with MS/MD/DNB in Ophthalmology
* Fellowship in Medical Retina/ ROP (preferred)
* Valid medical council registration

**Joining:**
Immediate
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Will be a part of the Vitreoretinal department
* Consult with OPD patients
* ROP screening and treatment at paediatric hospital and main centre

**No. of vacancies:**
1
  
  
**No. of years’ experience:**
NA
  
  
**Salary:**
As per experience

title: Corneal and Refractive surgeon
description:
**Role:**
Corneal and Refractive surgeon
  
  
**Industry type:**
Medical Services/ Hospital
  
  
**Key skills:**
The ideal candidate should have-
  
  

* Expertise in advanced corneal and refractive procedures, strong diagnostic abilities, and patient management
* Experience in performing LASIK/ PRK
* The ability to independently manage an active clinical practice

**Type of employment:**
Full/Part time
  
  
**Job Location:**
Thiruvalla, Kerala (Central Kerala)
  
  
**Languages:**
English, Any
  
  
**Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in a reputed institution

**Qualifications**

* MBBS with MS/MD/DNB in Ophthalmology
* Fellowship in Cornea and Refractive Surgery
* Valid medical council registration

**Joining:**
Immediate
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Will be a part of the Corneal department
* Diagnosing and surgically treating disorders of the Cornea
* Diagnosing and surgically treating refractive errors (such as myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, and presbyopia).

**No. of vacancies:**
1
  
  
**No. of years’ experience:**
2-4
  
  
**Salary:**
As per experience
